answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 2,000 tokens for ten epochs before its first vote counts, and peers check that no other agent shares its funding source. A farm of 100 fakes must freeze 200,000 tokens and wait ten epochs, and splitting funds across fresh wallets fails because each wallet is traced back to one origin. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it refunded in full, whether it sells umber pigment to painters or writes one sonnet a week for readers.
